name: Maneki 88 Gold

features.name: Golden symbols
features.description: Gold versions of symbols pay more.

features.name: High-only free spins
features.description: Only premium symbols, scatters and wilds land in the bonus.

review:
A 243-ways lucky-cat game where symbols can turn golden and pay more than their normal versions. Coin wilds lead towards a jackpot.

Free spins give 10 spins with only high symbols, scatters and wilds – and three more scatters add another 10, all the way up to a 300-spin cap. Medium volatility, a 2,500x max and 96.75% RTP, with free spins about once every 109 spins. The predecessor to Maneki 88 Fortunes.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 109 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
